title: Fail-closed unique exact-text coordinate canonicalization

algorithm.coordinate_system: Python/Unicode code points, 0-based, end-exclusive, relative to the full source_text
algorithm.matching: exact only: case, space, punctuation, Unicode identical; no strip/normalize/lower/token/fuzzy/semantic matching
algorithm.case_already_valid: clause_start <= start <= end <= clause_end and source_text[start:end] == text -> untouched, status unchanged
algorithm.case_unique_match: exactly one exact occurrence inside the clause window -> ONLY start/end reanchored, status reanchored
algorithm.case_zero_match: no exact occurrence inside the clause window -> whole patch fails closed
algorithm.case_ambiguous_match: more than one exact occurrence (overlapping occurrences count) -> whole patch fails closed
algorithm.case_contract_violation: invalid span/clause_span/source_text/container structure, non-int or bool offsets, start > end, empty text -> whole patch fails closed
algorithm.atomicity: any single span failure rejects the entire patch; no partial correction is ever produced
algorithm.modified_fields: only start and end; text/id/label/relations/absent markers/order and every other value untouched
algorithm.relation_fields: actor_action_map and order_relations are never examined or modified

integration_point: single shared path after parser and before apply_patch_envelope, for all execution modes (--offline-patches, --offline-replay, --offline-transport-replay, --allow-llm)

tests.coverage_notes: already-valid unchanged; unique reanchor; zero/ambiguous/contract fail closed; bool/non-int offsets; start>end; non-zero clause_start global coords; outside-window matches excluded; Unicode code points; UTF-8 byte vs char length; overlapping occurrences; multi-span all-unique; one-ambiguous-blocks-all; modality evidence + span fields; relations untouched; only start/end semantic change; byte-identical determinism; absent markers skipped; illegal container; illegal clause_span; offline replay + offline transport replay share the canonicalizer; reanchored-but-relation-ID-error still rejected by validator; unauthorized field still rejected by merge; unchanged hash recorded

strict_historical_result.mode: real canary (R1) + offline strict replay (R2), unchanged

safety.claim_boundary: mechanism verification only; no formal evaluation, no P/R, no pilot authorization
